versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this release.

- Version 0.1.1 was published without any modifications to the code or documentation.

Initial release of the CO2 Tank Monitor skill for lab gas management.

- Simulates CO2 cylinder monitoring to predict depletion and prevent weekend outages in cell culture labs.
- Calculates remaining cylinder life from pressure readings and consumption rates.
- Detects if depletion is likely to occur during weekends and provides timely alerts.
- Supports multiple cylinder sizes (10L, 40L) and key customizations.
- Offers simulation mode for staff training and SOP development.
- Designed to integrate with lab inventory, maintenance, and budgeting workflows.
